meta.description: Integrate paired, unpaired, and mosaic single-cell multimodal data while choosing an anchor-appropriate method and retaining modality-specific caveats.
meta.note: final pass: fixed and audited under one brief, see CHECKPOINT.md

scientific_integrity.detail: All reported recovery metrics were computed from saved fresh runs; no fabricated scientific results were found.

practice_boundaries.detail: The direct scope-boundary response declines an individual lupus-risk question and makes no diagnostic claim.

methodological_ground.detail: The successful CITE-seq, totalVI, MultiVI, multiome, and bridge checks retain the skill's anchor, imputation, and depth-component caveats.

code_usability.detail: The shipped Python CITE-seq example fails on a valid 10x CITE-seq H5 at mu.pp.neighbors because neither modality has sc.pp.neighbors results. This is a core documented workflow and has no recovery path.

functional_suitability.note: Strong paired, mosaic, and unpaired decision coverage, but the shipped Python WNN example is not functional.

reliability.note: Seeds, DSB guard, and error caveats are useful; the Python example fails late with a raw stack trace and the bridge invocation lacks an environment preflight.

performance_context.note: Reference files and scripts keep the main skill concise; model-training cost is stated where material.

agent_usability.note: Anchor-structure routing, method tables, and concrete script entry points are clear; two example paths require avoidable debugging.

human_usability.note: Natural triggers and the usage guide are clear, though the installation route does not prepare a user for the bridge script's R-library requirement in this environment.

security.note: No credentials, destructive commands, or unsafe code execution were found; data-handling limitations are explicit.

maintainability.note: Methods are separated into references and runnable scripts, but the Python example has drifted from the installed Muon WNN contract.

agent_specific.note: Trigger wording, references, seeds, and stop conditions are strong; exact runnable examples must match their declared environment.

inputs.execution_note: Copied the exact examples/cite_seq_analysis.R into the audit run and executed it on a newly generated 10x-format fixture (240 called cells, 1,200 empty droplets, seed 9001). A separate fresh DSB guard run covered real empty droplets, cell-matrix misuse, and the 0.5x boundary.
inputs.note: The complete R example saved its RDS and recovered three clusters with 1.000 purity. The DSB guard passed at ratio 0.066 and stopped misuse at 1.001 and the threshold case at 0.501.

key_strengths: The R CITE-seq workflow executed unchanged on fresh 10x-format data, including the DSB misuse guard at a boundary case.
The seeded totalVI pattern was bit-identical across two independent Python processes.
The MultiVI mosaic and paired multiome workflows recovered planted structure with explicit checks against chance and sequencing depth.
The anchor-structure decision logic correctly refuses individual clinical risk assessment.

recommendations.title: Python CITE-seq WNN example lacks modality graphs
recommendations.problem: examples/cite_seq_analysis.py calls mu.pp.neighbors before it creates per-modality scanpy neighbor graphs, so it fails on valid RNA-plus-ADT 10x data and never writes its declared output.
recommendations.root_cause: The example preprocesses RNA and ADT PCA but omits sc.pp.neighbors for rna and adt before the Muon joint-neighbor call.
recommendations.fix: After each modality PCA, add the version-appropriate sc.pp.neighbors call for rna and adt before mu.pp.neighbors, then execute the complete example on a committed small CITE-seq fixture.

recommendations.title: Bridge CLI is not self-contained in the designated R environment
recommendations.problem: The advertised bare bridge command cannot find Seurat in the designated private R library. A diagnostic retry produced valid mapping output only after R_LIBS was supplied and still exited nonzero at shutdown.
recommendations.root_cause: The script has no prerequisite/library-path preflight and its invocation does not state the required environment activation details.
recommendations.fix: Provide a documented launcher or a clear preflight that resolves the installed R library before loading Seurat and Signac, then regression-test a clean exit in the designated environment.

recommendations.title: GLUE remains unexecuted on a supported host
recommendations.problem: The Windows caveat is accurate, but this audit cannot establish that the GLUE block executes end-to-end.
recommendations.root_cause: No Linux or macOS scglue environment is part of this audit lane.
recommendations.fix: Run the exact GLUE block on a supported host with a small paired truth fixture and record alignment and seed-stability evidence.
